mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sku (shop_id, category_id, product_name, product_desc, product_type, price, stock, delivery_content, cover_url, status, operator_id) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{categoryId}, #{productName}, #{productDesc}, #{productType}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{deliveryContent}, #{coverUrl}, #{status}, #{operatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sku SET status = #{status}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
